predictions.rationale: Main concrete class representing a Sequence Diagram type inside the sequence2 diagram subsystem; central to creation, behaviour and persistence of sequence diagrams.
Provides the graph model (semantic backbone) for sequence diagrams, defining how UML interaction elements map to diagram nodes/edges.
Responsible for rendering figures for sequence-diagram elements (objects, lifelines, messages), thus directly supports visual display.
Factory that instantiates UMLSequenceDiagram objects and associated graph models/renderers; key to creating new sequence diagrams.
Module activator/registrar that integrates the sequence2 diagram implementation into ArgoUML; without it the feature is unavailable.
Legacy or façade class in core app package representing a sequence diagram; still relevant for compatibility and high-level operations.
Creates property panels specific to sequence diagrams, allowing users to edit diagram properties; directly supports the feature’s UI.
UI action that the user invokes to create/open a sequence diagram; bridges menu/toolbar interaction with diagram creation logic.
Explorer navigation rule exposing sequence diagrams under classifiers, enhancing usability and navigation for the feature.
Explorer rule that links operations to sequence diagrams representing their behaviour, providing contextual access to the feature.
